title: KKE Jiggle Demo
description: Jiggle physics: a jelly on a plate with balls bouncing off it (lattice shape matching), and a realistic woman, auto-rigged at load, with soft-tissue bones that jiggle and strand hair that swings as she jogs, jumps and stops. The body scene needs female_body (or a Synty character pack) in assets/synty/ (never committed).
